title: Scrape
description:
Deal 7 damage.
Draw 4 cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 Energy.
upgraded_description:
Deal 10 damage.
Draw 5 cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 Energy.
notes: Only zero-cost cards are kept; all other drawn cards are discarded. This creates a risk/reward scenario where you draw cards hoping to find zero-cost options to retain.
